title: Fixed Hairpin Stepped Pools and Side Slots
description: One complete newly authored static hairpin stepped-pool channel. A single connected grounded finite-thickness body contains a high left entrance, three descending left-flight floor terraces, one broad rear turning pool, and three descending right-return terraces ending at a low front exit beside the entrance. A full central divider ends before the rear pool, leaving the real U-turn open. Four complete cross-baffles in the two parallel flights have true full-height side slots alternating between outside bank and centre divider. The surrounding banks step with the floors and have complete upper coping surfaces. Unlike the old right-angle drop drain this is a returned dual-flight channel with an internal long divider and rear turning chamber, not a perpendicular two-mouth elbow or added covers. Unlike the two-well reclaim basin it has two open front channel mouths, a full folded route, stepped return and alternating full-height baffle gaps rather than a local weir saddle and small side outlets. All visible coordinates newly authored as one closed body, no older mesh imported. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre-style Z up and bounds-centred ground sole, one civil-architecture model zero scenes. Empty dry fishway-inspired artistic display only; no water, fauna, calculated flow, water depth, fish passage, ecological suitability, hydraulic efficiency, erosion resistance, structural load, installation, pedestrian access, engineering or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
